newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight quiet, some new business.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight quiet, some new business.

text.p: Some new inquiry was heard in the sugar freight market on Thursday but reported fixings were few.
New business included E D & F Man 16,000 tonnes bagged sugar from W Coast Guatemala to Colombo spot.
Genoc has 14,000 bagged from W Coast Guatemala to East Africa option Sri Lanka/Karachi range for 20-30 April. And Booker has 8,800-9,300 tonnes bulk from Georgetown Guyana to Lisbon for mid-April.
Fixtures included Genoc 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar Poland to Algeria option Egyptian Med/ Red Sea/ Pakistan/ Colombo or Bangla Desh.
Sofracom fixed 12,000 tonnes bulk sugar Reunion to Marseilles or Nantes for mid-April.
